texts.at-0002: Normalize amounts with to_money before comparing Convert any incoming amount through ledgerly.money.to_money (and compare against ZERO) before storing it on a LineItem, so floats and strings become Decimal and invalid types raise BillingError.
texts.at-0003: Reject bools and non-int quantities When validating integer quantities, explicitly exclude bool via isinstance(quantity, bool) before the int check, since True/False are ints in Python.

review_comments: [team convention] Every operation that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept an optional keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` (callers without a key keep working). Check the key first, before validating state: if an audit entry with the same key already exists (ledgerly.audit.events()), return the original result (for functions that return a record, the same record) without applying the operation again. Include `idempotency_key` in the audit entry you write. Introduced after the double-refund incident INC-204.

[team convention] Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 need a second approver (finance policy FIN-2026-03): accept an optional keyword-only `approved_by=None` (callers that do not need approval keep working). Amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval; above it, raise BillingError("approval_required") when `approved_by` is missing.

item.title: Money operations accept idempotency_key and check it first
item.content: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance (e.g. refund in ledgerly/adjustments.py) must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None`, check ledgerly.audit.events() for an existing entry with that key before any state validation, return the original result without reapplying, and include idempotency_key in the audit.record call.

item.title: Refunds above 500.00 require approved_by
item.content: Per finance policy FIN-2026-03, support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 must accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise BillingError("approval_required") when it is missing; amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval. Define the threshold as APPROVAL_THRESHOLD = round_money("500.00") in ledgerly/adjustments.py.
